usageNotes: Use this to discard pending network configuration changes on a node — it reverts the in-memory/staged config back to the last applied state without rebooting or reloading interfaces. This is the safe escape hatch when you have used POST /nodes/{node}/network or PUT /nodes/{node}/network/{iface} to stage changes but have not yet applied them with PUT /nodes/{node}/network. The node must be online and reachable; the caller requires Sys.Modify on /nodes/{node}.

examples.summary: Discard all staged network changes on node pve1

destructiveReason: Permanently discards all staged (unapplied) network interface changes on the node; any interface additions, edits, or deletions that have not yet been applied via PUT /nodes/{node}/network will be lost with no recovery path.
tips: Returns null — a 200 with an empty body is success; no UPID is issued because this operation is synchronous.
Only staged (not-yet-applied) changes are reverted; live interface state on the running node is untouched.
Check for pending changes first with GET /nodes/{node}/network and look for entries where 'pending' fields differ from 'active' fields.
This is the complement to PUT /nodes/{node}/network (apply); use this instead of apply if you want to abandon the changes.
